comments.author: Affectionate_Tie357
comments.body: How did you do these models and animations with ai?

replies.author: slaughter_cats
replies.body: The models and animations were not done with AI, the vast majority of it was not done with AI but as mentioned above i used it for the intro song, some 2d art and also some 3d meshes.

replies.author: Affectionate_Tie357
replies.body:
This could end up hindering your game's success with the amount of people turned off by AI. If you've already done this much on your own you should take the time to hand make as much of the ai assets as possible.

There are plenty of musicians looking for experience on r/INAT who will bring your game a unique theme. The song is very generic and boring (even for suno standards, try v5.5 if you haven't).

This is the sort of game that could go mini-viral if marketed correctly but ai will kill it because the market has not accepted AI yet

replies.author: slaughter_cats
replies.body:
No i disagree, i used AI a little in my previous game, had the steam disclaimer, i think there was one or 2 or people who complained about it but most people didn't care and that sold pretty well. Most people don't care, there's just a small minority who are very vocal by the seems of it. There's been quite a few successful games using AI so i don't think it's a big issue, either way i'm happy to use AI. 

I like the song as with everything including the game itself it's subjective, it's the stupidness and the right sound i was after. Also that is the only song which is AI in the game.
